exposure: physical activity level in the third trimester (sedentary, moderate-intensity, household/caregiving activity)
outcome: gestational age at birth (time of labor onset)
cohort: Two hundred and sixty women with low-risk pregnancies who gave birth at 37 weeks of gestation or beyond and completed the Pregnancy Physical Activity Questionnaire.
finding: Physical activity in the third trimester was associated with the time of labor onset, with decreased moderate-intensity and household/caregiving activity levels and increased sedentary activity found in women who gave birth at >=41 weeks of gestation.
mod_finding: The level of sedentary activity was higher in women who gave birth by a cesarean section compared to those who gave birth vaginally.
cross-section timing: Third trimester of pregnancy and at delivery
gest_age: Included women giving birth at 37 weeks of gestation or beyond; compared groups of >=41 weeks and 37-40 6/7 weeks.
